hypothesis: A gamma-0.65 covariance operator fitted to matched same-target cross-donor consensus effects improves complete-gallery PDS over the incumbent stacked-donor covariance without reducing signed directional credit.

candidate.name: consensus:g=0.65:eta=0.25
candidate.construction: Invert the frozen incumbent whitener to reconstruct q_pre, apply the audited consensus operator, then blend normalized identity and consensus directions with eta 0.25 while restoring the identity row norm.

evaluation.pds: Exact cosine complete-gallery PDS with stable midranks over all 613 targets.
evaluation.aggregation: Average the two K562 datasets first, then equally average K562, RPE1, and Jurkat.

target_alignment_null.operation: Derange candidate-minus-identity row increments among targets within each frozen outer fold, use the same permutation for both roles, restore identity row norms, and rescore against the complete gallery.
target_alignment_null.run_condition: Run only if every pre-null promotion gate passes.
